question: What dark-colored aspect is accessed by resorting to the place of the yogini?
premises: One resorts to the place of the yogini.
There is something dark and black-colored there.
This is the object of focus or attainment.
inference: By resorting to the yogini's place, one accesses the dark, black-colored aspect.
plain_english: Having resorted to the place of the yogini, one encounters the dark, black-colored form.
